{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md <<'EOF'
# Specification Quality Checklist: Add Two Numbers Utility

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness and quality before proceeding to planning
**Created**: 2026-10-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

## Content Quality

- [x] No implementation details (languages, frameworks, APIs)
- [x] Focused on user value and business needs
- [x] Written for non-technical stakeholders
- [x] All mandatory sections completed

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers remain
- [x] Requirements are testable and unambiguous
- [x] Success criteria are measurable
- [x] Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no implementation details)
- [x] All acceptance scenarios are defined
- [x] Edge cases are identified
- [x] Scope is clearly bounded
- [x] Dependencies and assumptions identified

## Feature Readiness

- [x] All functional requirements have clear acceptance criteria
- [x] User scenarios cover primary flows
- [x] Feature meets measurable outcomes defined in Success Criteria
- [x] No implementation details leak into specification

## Notes

- All items pass on first validation iteration (2026-10-16).
- User-facing behavior is expressed in terms of inputs/sums; the only named
  artifact (smoke.py) and runner (pytest) come from the issue's explicit
  requirements R01/R03 and are treated as constraints, not design choices.
- No [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers were needed: all unspecified details have
  reasonable defaults documented in the Assumptions section.
EOF
echo '{"feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"}' > .specify/feature.json && echo '--- checklist written ---' && cat .specify/feature.json && echo '--- residual placeholder scan ---' && grep -nE 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION|\[FEATURE NAME\]|\[DATE\]|\[Brief Title\]|\[specific|\[initial state\]|\[action\]|\[expected outcome\]|\[Assumption|\[Measurable metric|\[Entity' specs/001-transactions/spec.md || echo 'CLEAN: no placeholders' && echo '--- section scan ---' && grep -nE '^#{1,3} ' specs/001-transactions/spec.md"}
